correction on true where answer.id = #{customerAnswerId} and answer.create_user = #{userId} and answer.do_right = FALSE

with wrong_answers as ( select id, question_id, question_type, subject_id, create_time from t_exam_paper_question_customer_answer where do_right = FALSE and create_user = #{createUser} ), grouped as ( select question_id, count(*) as wrong_count, max(create_time) as latest_wrong_time from wrong_answers group by question_id ), latest as ( select distinct on (question_id) * from wrong_answers order by question_id, create_time desc, id desc ) select latest.id, latest.question_id, latest.id as latest_customer_answer_id, latest.question_type, to_char(latest.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as create_time, to_char(grouped.latest_wrong_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as latest_wrong_time, subject.name as subject_name, coalesce(nullif(question.knowledge_point, ''), '未分类') as knowledge_point, grouped.wrong_count, correction.review_status as correction_status, correction.review_comment as review_comment from grouped inner join latest on latest.question_id = grouped.question_id inner join t_question question on question.id = latest.question_id left join t_subject subject on subject.id = latest.subject_id left join lateral ( select review_status, review_comment from t_question_correction_record where deleted = false and customer_answer_id = latest.id and user_id = #{createUser} order by id desc limit 1 ) correction on true
and correction.review_status is null
and correction.review_status = #{correctionStatus}
order by coalesce(nullif(question.knowledge_point, ''), '未分类') asc, grouped.wrong_count desc, grouped.latest_wrong_time desc, latest.id desc

select answer.id as customer_answer_id, answer.exam_paper_answer_id, answer.exam_paper_id, paper_answer.paper_name, answer.create_time, paper_answer.user_score, correction.review_status as correction_status, correction.review_comment as review_comment from t_exam_paper_question_customer_answer answer left join t_exam_paper_answer paper_answer on paper_answer.id = answer.exam_paper_answer_id left join lateral ( select review_status, review_comment from t_question_correction_record where deleted = false and customer_answer_id = answer.id and user_id = #{userId} order by id desc limit 1 ) correction on true where answer.do_right = FALSE and answer.create_user = #{userId} and answer.question_id = #{questionId} order by answer.create_time desc, answer.id desc
